create_dataset_subclass: create a subclass of DatasetBase that implements __len__ and __getitem__ for custom frame data
get_sequence_names: get an iterator over all sequence names in a DatasetBase instance
get_category_to_sequence_names: get a dict mapping each dataset category to its list of sequence names
iterate_sequence_frames_in_order: iterate over sorted frame triplets of timestamp, frame number, and dataset index for a sequence
join_datasets: join multiple DatasetBase instances of the same type into the current dataset
